Name: Kedi's Movie Concession Retextures
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=2]Vanilla concessions always felt so low effort and not shaded properly to me so I wanted to give them new looks in my style, except I didn't feel like changing Salmon Burger and Rock Candy, as they looked mostly fine to me. Enjoy![/size]

[size=3][b]Features[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]New looks for almost all vanilla concessions[/size]
[*][size=3]Configs for every one of them, so you can disable certain ones if you don't like them or prefer another mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Joja Popcorn has 3 versions instead of one, because I didn't want to restrict users.[/size]
[/list][size=2]Let me know in the comments if you have any suggestions, and endorse it if you like it![/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108727003?tab=user+files]Check my other mods out![/url]﻿[/size]
